title: Handling of network rejection due to ESM cause other than ESM cause #26

entities.name: PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to request PDN connectivity.

entities.name: PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by network to reject PDN connectivity request.

entities.name: ATTACH REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by network to reject attach request.

entities.name: ESM cause IE
entities.description: Information element indicating the reason for ESM procedure rejection.

entities.name: Back-off timer
entities.description: Timer used to prevent UE from sending PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST messages for specific APN/PLMN combinations.

entities.name: Standalone PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST
entities.description: Condition where PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST is sent without ATTACH REQUEST.

entities.name: PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST with ATTACH REQUEST
entities.description: Condition where PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST is sent together with ATTACH REQUEST.

entities.name: Integrity protected ATTACH REJECT
entities.description: Condition where ATTACH REJECT message is integrity protected.

entities.name: Back-off timer started

entities.name: Back-off timer deactivated
entities.description: Property indicating that back-off timer is deactivated for specific APN/PLMN combination.

relations.description: PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT message contains ESM cause IE indicating rejection reason.
PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT message may contain Back-off timer value IE.
PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT message may contain Re-attempt indicator IE.
PDN connectivity procedure includes sending PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message.
PDN connectivity procedure may start back-off timer upon rejection.
When PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST is sent standalone and Back-off timer value IE is included with non-zero value, UE starts back-off timer.
When PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST is sent standalone and Back-off timer value IE indicates deactivated, UE deactivates back-off timer.
When PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST is sent with ATTACH REQUEST and Back-off timer value IE is included with non-zero value, UE starts back-off timer.
When ATTACH REJECT is integrity protected and Back-off timer value IE is included with non-zero value, UE starts back-off timer.
ATTACH REJECT message may or may not be integrity protected, affecting UE behavior.
Back-off timer value IE determines whether timer is started, deactivated, or set to zero.
Re-attempt indicator IE affects whether back-off timer is started for equivalent PLMNs.
